usedFor: Wrike holds folders, projects and tasks, LeadConnector holds contacts, and “Task Shareds Added” can feed “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Project Dates Changed” in Wrike, then “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A project's start or end dates changing is a clear signal, and the action tags a contact in LeadConnector.

watchOut: “Folder Title Changed” and “Task Description Changed” fire on edits, so “Create Or Update Contact” can run repeatedly.
